title: Kok-boru
tagline: Gallop, grab and throw in the great team horse game of the steppe.
description: Kok-boru is the team horse game of the Central Asian steppe. Steer a galloping rider, scoop the heavy ball from the ground, tug it from a rival, pass to a team-mate and throw it into the sand circle. Climb the five-rung Steppe Ladder, ask Think for advice or watch computer teams play in Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Drag with your left thumb to ride; hold SPRINT for a burst.
Ease off near the ball: the ring turns green, then press GRAB.
Alongside a rival with the ball? The same button tugs it away.
Hold THROW and let go when the landing ring is inside the circle.
PASS to an open team-mate, and win the match with more goals.
